subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Third-Party Vendor Risk
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Third-Party Vendor Risk.

hook.text: Your cloud provider has a breach. Your customer data leaks. Your customers sue you, not the provider.

buildup.text: Third-party risk management tracks the security posture of every vendor with access to your data.

discovery.text: Regulations like DORA and NYDFS now require formal vendor risk assessments and ongoing monitoring.

twist.text: Companies average 100+ vendors with data access. Monitoring them all requires dedicated teams and tools.

climax.text: You can outsource the work but never the liability. Vendor risk is ultimately your risk.

punchline.text: Outsource the work. Keep the liability. That's the deal.

quiz.question: Who is liable when a vendor breach exposes your customer data?
options: Your company still bears the liability
No one is liable for third-party breaches
